question: In India the principle of 'procedure established by law' is taken from which constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Procedure established by law:-**

 
 
• It means that a law has been duly enacted by the competent body following the correct procedure. For example, the procedure mentioned in the constitution.
 
• The Doctrine of Procedure established by law has been taken from the Japanese Constitution.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
